text_en: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the parent loves the child.
text_cn: 凡信耶稣为默西亚的，是由天主所生的；凡爱生他之父的，也必爱那由他所生的。

text_en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and obey his commandments.
text_cn: 几时我们爱天主，又遵行他的诫命，由此知道我们真爱天主的子女。

text_en: For the love of God is this, that we obey his commandments. And his commandments are not burdensome,
text_cn: 原来爱天主，就是遵行他的诫命，而他的诫命并不沉重，

text_en: for whatever is born of God conquers the world. And this is the victory that conquers the world, our faith.
text_cn: 因为凡是由天主所生的，必得胜世界；得胜世界的胜利武器，就是我们的信德。

text_en: Who is it that conquers the world but the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
text_cn: 谁是得胜世界的呢？不是那信耶稣为天主子的人吗？

text_en: This is the one who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ, not with the water only but with the water and the blood. And the Spirit is the one that testifies, for the Spirit is the truth.
text_cn: 这位就是经过水及血而来的耶稣基督，他不但以水，而且也是以水及血而来的；并且有圣神作证，因为圣神是真理。

text_en: There are three that testify:
text_cn: 原来作证的有三个：

text_en: the Spirit and the water and the blood, and these three agree.
text_cn: 就是圣神，水及血，而这三个是一致的。

text_en: If we receive human testimony, the testimony of God is greater; for this is the testimony of God that he has testified to his Son.
text_cn: 人的证据，我们既然接受，但天主的证据更大，因为天主的证据就是他为自己的子作证。

text_en: Those who believe in the Son of God have the testimony in their hearts. Those who do not believe in God have made him a liar by not believing in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
text_cn: 那信天主子的，在自己内就怀有这证据；那不信天主的，就是以天主为撒谎者，因为他不信天主为自己的子所作的证。

text_en: And this is the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
text_cn: 这证据就是天主将永远的生命赐给了我们，而这生命是在自己的子内。

text_en: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
text_cn: 那有子的，就有生命；那没有天主子的，就没有生命。

text_en: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
text_cn: 我给你们这些信天主子名字的人，写了这些事，是为叫你们知道：你们已获有永远的生命。

text_en: And this is the boldness we have in him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
text_cn: 我们对天主所怀的依恃之心就是：如果我们按他的旨意求什么，他必俯听我们。

text_en: And if we know that he hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have obtained the requests made of him.
text_cn: 我们既然知道：我们不拘向他祈求什么，他会俯听我们，我们也知道向他所祈求的，必要得到。

text_en: If you see your brother or sister committing what is not a mortal sin, you will ask, and God will give life to such a one—to those whose sin is not mortal. There is sin that is mortal; I do not say that you should pray about that.
text_cn: 谁若看见自己的弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，就应当祈求，天主必赏赐他生命：这是为那些犯不至于死的罪人而说的；然而有的罪却是至于死的罪，为这样的罪，我不说要人祈求。

text_en: All wrongdoing is sin, but there is sin that is not mortal.
text_cn: 任何的不义都是罪过，但也有不至于死的罪过。

text_en: We know that those who are born of God do not sin, but the one who was born of God protects them, and the evil one does not touch them.
text_cn: 我们知道：凡由天主生的，就不犯罪过；而且由天主生的那一位必保全他，那恶者不能侵犯他。

text_en: We know that we are God’s children, and that the whole world lies under the power of the evil one.
text_cn: 我们知道我们属于天主，而全世界却屈服于恶者。

text_en: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we may know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
text_cn: 我们也知道天主子来了，赐给了我们理智，叫我们认识那真实者；我们确实是在那真实者内，即在他的子耶稣基督内，他即是真实的天主和永远的生命。

text_en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
text_cn: 孩子们，你们要谨慎，远避偶像！
